# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name (builders 1 and 2: 61af9e0d, dcd2fec7, 550cc033, bd3bf88d)

- Gate: `identify` (`server/database-ports.ts`; stand-in `stand-in-ports.ts`) refuses an
  account with no own profile (`profile_access` `self`) as `name-needed`; pages send it to
  `/account?next=` (S-125), which draws the one name screen. Commands `give-own-name.ts`,
  `change-own-name.ts` (core, people); form `own-name-form.tsx`; `own-name-actions.ts`.
- Web unit tests sign in through `named-identify.test-helper.ts`; browser tests answer the
  screen through the kit's `answerNameScreen`. No name (T-447): stand-in `local-unnamed-token`,
  seed `owner@lakeside.example.test`.

## Layer 2, the password (builder 3; T-451, T-452, S-127)

- The interface (`packages/providers/src/sign-in/sign-in-service.ts`) offered no password
  change: only `setPassword` (needs a code's proof), `confirmPassword` (checks, changes
  nothing), `signOutEverywhere` (keep this one or not). Composing them would leave a gap
  between the check and the change and a second guess count, so (T-451) it gains
  `changePassword({ accessToken, oldPassword, newPassword, networkAddress })`: the old one
  counted as `confirmPassword`'s guesses are (T-225, per address and network), the new one
  by `setPassword`'s rule, every other session ended, this one kept. Both adapters: the
  stand-in (`local/local-sign-in.ts`) and Supabase (`supabase/supabase-sign-in.ts`: a
  password sign-in checks the old one, then `PUT /user`, then sign out `others`).
- Done (0584915a, d52a7897): command `server/sign-in/change-own-password.ts` (T-452; mails
  once via `mail.passwordChanged`), action `password-actions.ts` (refresh), form
  `features/sign-in/change-password-form.tsx`; P6 corrected; S-127 (Google-only accounts).
- Passed: sign-in units (297), test:web, change-password-test (fails with the stand-in
  keeping other sessions), demo-hidden-numbers, kept-emails, people-on-database (mended:
  a seed person signed in twice is asked the name once), simulated-league, staff-numbers,
  test-copy-says, test-copy, harmful-text (password boxes are posted kinds: no pin).
- FAILS, not mended: admins-invitations-test. The seed owner answers the name screen as
  "Made-up Signer" (no longer "Ola Lakeside"), the volunteer now has a name so A-14's
  "No name yet" cannot occur for a new sign-up, and Adele Admin and Sky Scorer were not
  listed at all (not understood). Needs: names per person, the A-14 check rethought.
- Distrust: Supabase's change is unverified live (a "secure password change" setting
  would ask a nonce); `fence-filter-check` not run (no query file changed).

## Layer 3, the email (not started)

- Needs: a pending change of email (migration 0031, `npm run db:types`), a 6-digit code to
  the new address through the sign-in interface (an adapter call in both), a notice to the
  old one, the email changed only by T-73's confirmed change (T-256: owner-run function).
